routes.name: US Gulf Coast oil exports
routes.notes: Surged to record volumes following shift in global energy flows; primary destination Asia via Panama Canal.

routes.name: Australia–Asia LNG route
routes.notes: Critical energy artery for East Asia; Australia provides 30% of Asian LNG supply.

routes.name: Brazil–China iron ore route
routes.notes: Dominanted by Valemax VLOCs; essential for China's steel production and infrastructure.

routes.name: Africa–Europe (West Africa-Rotterdam)
routes.notes: Key route for West African resources; faces piracy risks in the Gulf of Guinea.

routes.name: Arctic route (Northern Sea Route)
routes.notes: Emerging seasonal shortcut between Europe and Asia; growth driven by ice melt and Russian energy exports.

routes.name: Trans-Siberian rail
routes.notes: World's longest railway; vital for Russian domestic logistics and overland Asia-Europe transit.

routes.name: China–Europe rail (BRI)
routes.notes: Cornerstone of the Belt and Road Initiative; provides a faster alternative to sea and cheaper than air.

routes.name: India Ocean routes
routes.notes: Handles 50% of world's container traffic and 80% of seaborne oil; highly congested waypoints.

routes.name: Pacific islands routes
routes.notes: Lifeline for island nations; highly dependent on transshipment from regional hubs.

routes.name: East Asia-Europe
routes.notes: Traditional main route via Suez; currently impacted by Red Sea security disruptions forcing Cape diversions.

routes.name: Trans-Pacific
routes.notes: World's busiest container route; connects the world's two largest economies.

chokepoints.name: Danish Straits
chokepoints.summary: Connects the Baltic Sea to the North Sea. Critical for Russian oil exports and European trade.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Increased monitoring of 'shadow fleet' tankers due to sanctions on Russia.

chokepoints.name: Luzon Strait
chokepoints.summary: Key passage between the South China Sea and the Pacific Ocean. Vital for East Asian energy and resource imports.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Geopolitical tensions in the South China Sea and proximity to Taiwan.

chokepoints.name: Lombok Strait
chokepoints.summary: Deep-water alternative to the Strait of Malacca. Used by deep-draft tankers (post-Malaccamax) traveling between Australia and East Asia.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Volcanic activity and potential for maritime accidents in narrow passages.

chokepoints.name: Panama Canal
chokepoints.summary: Connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. Essential for US-Asia trade and grain exports.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Climate change-induced droughts affecting freshwater levels and transit capacity.

chokepoints.name: Cape Horn
chokepoints.summary: Strategic southern tip of South America. Serves as a primary alternative when the Panama Canal is restricted.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Extreme weather conditions and rogue waves pose significant navigation hazards.

chokepoints.name: Mozambique Channel
chokepoints.summary: Key route for tankers from the Middle East to the Atlantic. Vital alternative route if the Suez Canal is blocked.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Regional insurgency and maritime security concerns in Northern Mozambique.

chokepoints.name: Strait of Malacca
chokepoints.summary: Shortest sea route between the Middle East and East Asia. The world's primary energy chokepoint.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Extreme congestion, piracy risks, and high vulnerability to maritime blockades.

chokepoints.name: Suez Canal
chokepoints.summary: Shortest link between Europe and Asia. Handles nearly 30% of global container traffic.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Regional conflict instability and physical blockages (e.g., Ever Given incident).

chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.summary: The world's most critical oil chokepoint. Transits 20% of the world's total oil consumption daily.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Geopolitical military tensions and potential for closure due to regional conflict.

chokepoints.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
chokepoints.summary: The 'Gate of Grief' at the entrance to the Red Sea. Vital for all Suez Canal traffic.
chokepoints.currentThreat: Active military strikes on commercial shipping and regional civil war spillover.
